text:
Type: opal glass shade table lamp
Use: reading or ambient light on a desk, a sideboard or a bedside table; living room, bedroom, home office
Style: retro, classic, industrial
Materials: white opal glass shade, dark grey metal stem, rim and round base, metal pull chain
Colors: milky white, dark charcoal grey
Shape: conical glass shade with a rounded top resting on a metal ring, slender straight stem, round base, pull-chain switch, medium size
Feel: nostalgic, soft, elegant, calm
Goes with: dark wood, brass or black accents, deep wall colours; classic, retro or industrial rooms

product.name: LVNGEN
product.description: Creates a soft, cosy mood light in your room.
